android.importHelp: Or build it by hand: POST {url}, header Authorization: Bearer <key>, form body with a file field named file.
android.paste: Paste it in HTTP Shortcuts → Variables → gitvault_key.

auto.description: A shortcut on your phone sends the latest photos every night, without opening @:app.name.
auto.error: Couldn't load the backup status. Try again.

ios.addHelp: Opens the GitVault Backup shortcut in Shortcuts: tap Add Shortcut.
ios.automateHelp: Shortcuts → Automation → + → Time of Day → 02:00, Daily → Run Immediately → GitVault Backup.
ios.connectHelp: Hands an upload key to the shortcut, which runs a first backup. The key is saved in plain text in iCloud Drive (Shortcuts/GitVault/config.json) and syncs to your other Apple devices: anyone with that file can add photos to {repo}, nothing else. Revoke it above at any time.

key.label: Upload key
key.shownOnce: Copy it now: it is shown only once.
key.warning: Anyone with this key can add photos to {repo} with your GitHub account until you revoke it above.

auto.openOnPhone: Open this page on your iPhone to connect it.
auto.revokeHelp: Revoking stops uploads from that device within a minute. You stay signed in. To cut off everything at once, revoke @:app.name under GitHub Settings → Applications.
auto.stale: Nothing arrived in the last {days} days: check the automation on your phone.
